Actor Alleges Abuse and Non-Payment; Cine Workers' Body Seeks FIR

An actor associated with the film 'Laapataa Ladies' has publicly alleged non-payment and mistreatment, including physical and verbal abuse, by the makers of another film, 'Ped Palki'. A cine workers' body has taken note of these allegations and is demanding an investigation, seeking an FIR against the filmmaker.
